ns2:course.label: Plant Path Fungi and Nematodes
ns2:course.description: (PL PA 301) Principles of the biology, ecology and pathogenesis of fungi and nematodes that cause plant diseases; morphology, classification, and histories of these pathogens. Prerequisite: IB 103, MCB 100 and MCB 101, CPSC 352 or equivalent or consent of instructor. A course in biochemistry is recommended.
